maddeler.e:
أتحامل (form VI)
# أَتَحَامَلُ (ʔataḥāmalu) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.ma.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَحَامَلَ (taḥāmala)
# أَتَحَامَلَ (ʔataḥāmala) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.ma.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَحَامَلَ (taḥāmala)
# أَتَحَامَلْ (ʔataḥāmal) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.mal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَحَامَلَ (taḥāmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
